content:
While Apple is rolling out macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple is also rolling out macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8. Here's what's new.

"Important Security Fixes"

Today, Apple released macOS 27 Golden Gate, which introduces a new Siri AI and a dedicated app, new Apple Foundation Models, and improvements to Safari and Shortcuts, among others.

In addition, Apple is also rolling out macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8, which the company says include "important security fixes and are recommended for all users."

Apple has not yet updated its security release page to disclose what's included in these updates. However, looking at Apple's recent track record of important macOS security fixes, particularly those involving WebKit vulnerabilities, updating as soon as possible may be a good idea if you don't want to or can't upgrade to macOS 27.

macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8 have build numbers of 25G229 and 24H23, respectively, which are the same as their latest candidates.
